title: I Turned Claude Opus 5.5 Into a Viral Video Machine (Here's How)
one_sentence_summary: How to configure Claude Opus 5.5 with ElevenLabs and HyperFrames to automate the complete production of motion graphics videos from scratch.
key_takeaways: Connect Claude to a dedicated workspace folder containing your project files so it can read and write directly to your workspace.
Install the HyperFrames skill via the npm command to give Claude the capability to render complex motion graphics videos directly.
Extract downloaded skill zip folders before pointing Claude to them; otherwise, Claude will be unable to read the files.
Provide reference videos to Claude so it can mirror pacing, camera movements, transitions, and audio cues without copying the script or look.
Use Claude's built-in voices if you are on the free plan of ElevenLabs, as library voices require a paid plan when accessed via the API.

actionable_frameworks.name: Viral Video Machine
actionable_frameworks.description: An automated workflow combining Claude Opus 5.5, ElevenLabs, and HyperFrames to ingest scripts, fact-check against real sources, generate synchronized voiceovers, and produce complete motion-graphic videos without manual editing software.

memorable_quotes: Instead I built a video machine inside Claude. You give it a topic and it hands you a finished video just like this Titanic one.
The real question isn't how much money you have, it's whether it's growing faster than prices.
